_meta.description: Audit of c-prefixes whose regulation (NpcParam/ThinkParam/BehaviorParam) exists in the mod's regulation.bin and in vanilla ER, but which are unregistered in the rando's roster JSONs (nr_enemy_tags.json + nr_enemy_roster.json + heritage_pack.json + placement_budget.json). The Devonia (c5800) and SoTE Tree Sentinel (c6251) wirings done v0.28.x are the precedent — this is the systematic survey of everything else that fits that pattern.
_meta.scope: Ghost c-prefixes filtered to range c2xxx-c8xxx, excluding (a) chrs already wired in v0.28.x sessions (c5050, c5120, c5131, c5132, c5140, c5141, c5194, c6251, c5800), (b) known dummies/TEMP NAME entries, (c) nightlord/cinematic-only slots.
_meta.method: set difference between mod regulation NpcParam c-prefixes and roster all_variants c_prefixes

tier_S_sote_reuse_with_er_sibling._note: These are SoTE re-uses of ER chrs. Same shape as c6251/c3251 — should share a cap with the ER sibling once the shared-cap mechanism (see TODO_c6251_shared_cap.md) lands. 10 confirmed pairs; first one already wired (c6251 → c3251).
tier_S_sote_reuse_with_er_sibling._priority: low until shared-cap mechanism exists; then a one-shot batch wiring

tier_S_unidentified_c6xxx._note: c6xxx-range chrs with no obvious ER sibling by name. Could be SoTE-only chrs without an ER counterpart, OR could be variants whose ER counterpart has been renamed. Worth investigating before wiring — if they're sibling-less they go in tier A instead.

entries.note: Substantial variant count + medium HP — possibly a real chr identity

tier_A_sote_additions_high_value_boss_or._note: SoTE chrs with iconic moveset identities and no ER analog already in the rando. These are direct wins — same shape as c5800 Devonia wiring (4-file registration, no shared cap needed since they're unique to SoTE). Sorted by descending hp_max.
tier_A_sote_additions_high_value_boss_or._recommendation: Top 5-10 here are likely the most playable additions to the rando. Field-tier chrs are lower-risk than bosses (no phase mechanic concerns).

entries.name: Basilisk
entries.note: Death-mist breath; pair with c5350 Eyes

_animal_subset._note: Pure ambient SoTE wildlife. Low individual interest but useful as filler/atmosphere. Could be tagged as ghost_exclude or a low-cap grunt tier so they don't dominate slots.

tier_B_major_bosses_high_risk_high_rewar._note: Iconic ER/SoTE bosses absent from NR roster. Phase mechanics, EMEVD entanglement, multi-arena requirements make these expensive to wire correctly. Each is a multi-session project, not a batch-wire candidate.
tier_B_major_bosses_high_risk_high_rewar._recommendation: Pick 1-2 to attempt; do not batch.

entries.name: God-Devouring Serpent / Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy
Ancient Dragon Senessax
entries.complexity: Standard ancient dragon moveset; lowest risk of group

entries.name: Magma Wyrm (SoTE)
entries.complexity: Lava SFX; sibling to c4910 already in NR

tier_C_skip_or_investigate_only._note: NPCs, cinematic chrs, vehicle entities. Most have no useful combat moveset or are heavily scripted. Skip unless a specific need surfaces.
